title: Combat was the weakest part of our game, so we added a deck of cards out of everything you've unlocked during the game
author: awezoomstudios

comments.author: bingewavecinema
comments.body: Nice work around. is the game playable?

replies.author: awezoomstudios
replies.body:
yes, it is, but it's not an official demo, and it doesn't include this change yet. you can come to our discord and find the link to download it there so you can later provide feedback about your experience with it. :)

[https://discord.gg/NFphS2j5Z9](https://discord.gg/NFphS2j5Z9)

replies.author: promptling
replies.body: Turning unlocked content into a combat deck creates a very clean test question: do players understand why a card entered their deck and when it should change their decisions, or does it feel like another UI layer? I’m building [Patchloop](https://patchloop.io/) for AI built games and version-linked feedback. It could complement the Discord by keeping each response attached to the exact combat build being tested.

comments.author: awezoomstudios
comments.body: What do you think u/Redditry199 ? Looks better now?
